name: Giant Mosquito

items.name: Blood Drain
items.text:
Requirements The giant mosquito has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

---
Effect The giant mosquito uses its proboscis to drain blood from the grabbed or restrained creature. This deals 3d6 piercing damage (DC 24 basic Fortitude save save), and the giant mosquito gains temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt that last 1 minute. A creature that takes any damage from having its blood drained by a giant mosquito is Drained 1 until it receives any kind or amount of healing.

items.name: Septic Malaria
items.text:
The victim can't reduce its Sickened condition while it's affected by septic malaria

Saving Throw DC 24 Fortitude save

Onset 1 day

Stage 1 Sickened 1 (1 day)

Stage 2 Drained 1 and Sickened 1 (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 Unconscious (1 day)

Stage 5 dead

text: These horrifically enlarged versions of the common mosquito often prey upon megafauna like dinosaurs and other large creatures, but they won't turn down a chance to drink the blood of a smaller target-such as a humanoid.
